ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white) coverage concentrated at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white pigmentation patches located on the outer 20% of both lobe tips. The left lobe exhibits a series of vertical white streaks, while the right lobe contains a more solid white patch transitioning into mottled streaks toward the center.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an internal angle of approximately 50-60 degrees and a depth of approximately 10% of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extremely irregular trailing edge topography featuring high-frequency serrations and several distinct, deep indentations (nicks) varying from 5 to 15 pixels in depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Leading edges show a uniform convex curve extending from the peduncle to the tips. Trailing edges exhibit an overall concave curvature interrupted by significant marginal irregularities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, discrete high-intensity circular pixel clusters (1-4 pixels in diameter) scattered across the dark central and right-side regions, consistent with sessile organism attachment points.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertically oriented linear pixel disruptions of lower intensity relative to surrounding dark pixels, located primarily in the central lower region of the fluke.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular indentation and significant tissue loss on the trailing edge of the right lobe near the distal tip; multiple smaller nicks along the entire trailing boundary.
